items.title: Pave, an AI app builder from Quickbase, turns plain-language descriptions into business apps
points: Pave generates complete working apps (data structure, user roles, workflows) from plain-English descriptions like 'Build a project intake tracker,' without requiring developers
Integrates with 350+ external systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, Slack, Workday) so data syncs automatically instead of manual copy-paste between tools
Built-in approval workflows track sign-offs with a documented owner and status, preventing them from getting lost in email or chat
Meets IT security requirements by default: permissions ship with every app, user data never trains the AI models, and it runs on Quickbase's enterprise platform (25+ years operational track record)
A real-time demo showed the system building an intake app with dashboard and approval workflow from a single prompt
Free tier available, no credit card required to start building
A quality systems managing director built three separate apps in about 10 hours using time between meetings

issues.subject: ☕️ Your spreadsheet is running your company

headlines: Pave, an AI app builder from Quickbase, automatically generates business applications from plain-language descriptions—replacing spreadsheet-based workflows with proper approval systems, data connectors, and governance

sections.title: How Pave Solves the Spreadsheet Problem
points: 1. Users describe a business process in plain English (e.g., 'Build a project intake tracker'), and Pave generates a complete working app including data structure, user roles, and workflows without requiring developers
2. The platform integrates with 350+ external systems including Salesforce, NetSuite, Slack, and Workday, so data syncs automatically instead of requiring manual copy-paste between tools
3. Built-in approval workflows ensure sign-offs are tracked and don't disappear into email or chat—each approval has a documented owner and status

4. IT security requirements are met by default: permissions ship with every app, user data never trains the AI models, and the system runs on Quickbase's enterprise platform with 25+ years of operational track record

sections.title: Key Product Features
points: 1. Real-time demonstration shows system building an intake app with dashboard and approval workflow in response to a single natural-language prompt
2. Free tier available with no credit card required to start building
3. Real customer example: one quality systems managing director built three separate apps in approximately 10 hours using available time between meetings
